${\textsf{\color{#d4ab3b}byi:}}$ i rarely interact with people outside of my party, and on the off-chance that i do, be aware that i **often go afk without warning**, i am **typically off-tab**, and i will usually adjust to your behaviour *unless you are weird.* i **don't like nor need tone tags** and i am not fond of oversharing about myself. i tend to be skeptical and critical, so i apologise for my hesitance to believe certain things. i take a lot of things literally and usually respond in that way. i kin and have some boundaries around that.

${\textsf{\color{#d4ab3b}dni (or rather, i won't like you if you're...):}}$ overly sexual or **immature** - trying to start drama/conflict with others for fun. a hazbin/helluva fan. joking about wars, faking mental illnesses, or disrespecting religion _excluding cults_. romanticising criminals / obsessed with true crime, or praising/obsessing over gore. romanticising self-harm or other dangerous/illegal misconduct. flaunting abusing alcohol/drugs underage. narcissistic. an endogenic "system". born in 2010 and later **iwc**.
